lines.literal: Rabdi caps each target lifetime at 7,884,000 blocks (about 182 days). It does not support permanent/no-expiration entities. On SDK 1.0.1+, use `ExpirationTime.max()` for the longest lifetime. Only SDK 1.0.0 needs a below-maximum signing margin such as `ExpirationTime.fromBlocks(7_883_970)`; the sample retains a conservative cap for compatibility and defaults to 30 days. Use Lifetime Extension for data that needs to remain available longer. Historical measurement with SDK 1.0.0 on 2026-10-31: the near-maximum create was [verified on Rabdi](https://rabdi.explorer.arkiv.network/tx/0x541255b0a308664af00fa73228208495061979ddfb06ab26a7196095f998503a). Extension is relative to the current head or an absolute future block, not an additive duration; keep its target within the same maximum.
